meta.title: Modestsisters Shopify Ecommerce — Case Study | Teknoppy
meta.description: How Teknoppy built modestsisters.co on Shopify for a UAE modest fashion brand, with structured clothing and accessories categories and clear shipping and pricing messaging.

sections.h1Rest: Built for a UAE Modest Fashion Brand

paragraphs.text: Modestsisters is a UAE-based modest fashion brand selling handcrafted abayas, coord-sets, dresses, and tops, alongside jewelry and sunglasses.

items.title: No structured category hierarchy
items.text: Abayas, coord-sets, dresses, and tops, alongside jewelry and sunglasses, likely sat without a clear Clothing vs. Accessories split, making it harder for shoppers to move between product types.

items.title: No visible shipping terms
items.text: Without shipping information surfaced upfront, UAE customers had to reach checkout or ask directly before knowing delivery terms.

items.title: No consistent discount visibility
items.text: Sale pricing likely wasn't shown consistently across listings, making it harder for shoppers to spot current offers while browsing.

paragraphs.text: Teknoppy's goal was to build a Shopify store that could organize a growing clothing and accessories catalog into a clear structure, surface shipping and pricing information upfront, and give the brand's "effortless elegance and timeless luxury" positioning a storefront to match.

sections.caption: modestsisters.co — homepage as it appears today.

sections.h2: A comprehensive range of services offered by Teknoppy and their outcomes

items.title: Clothing and Accessories organized into structured categories
items.text: Abayas, Coord-Sets, Dresses, and Tops sit under Clothing; Necklaces, Rings, and Bracelets sit under Accessories; Sunglasses stands as its own category — giving shoppers a clear path through a growing catalog.

items.title: Free shipping messaging surfaced site-wide
items.text: A persistent banner ("Free shipping within UAE on all orders") sets delivery expectations before a customer ever reaches checkout.

items.title: Consistent sale pricing display
items.text: Original and discounted prices are shown together across product listings, making current offers easy to spot while browsing.

items.title: A direct Instagram support channel
items.text: Order support and general enquiries route to the brand's Instagram, meeting modest-fashion shoppers on the platform where they already engage with the brand.

sections.h2: Modestsisters' Final Outcome After Teknoppy's Work

items.q: What was the main goal of the Modestsisters Shopify project?
items.a: To build a store that organizes a growing modest fashion catalog into a clear structure while surfacing shipping and pricing information upfront.
Abayas, coord-sets, dresses, and tops, alongside necklaces, rings, bracelets, and sunglasses, shipped within the UAE.

items.q: Did the project affect Modestsisters' existing rankings?
items.a: The project was scoped to avoid keyword cannibalization across the site's category and product pages — no overlapping targets were introduced.
